packageRules.description: vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 must move across majors together (coverage-v8 pins vitest to the same major). The node preset already groups their minor/patch updates.
typescript-eslint's peer range is typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so a newer TypeScript fails `npm ci` with ERESOLVE. Raise or remove this cap when typescript-eslint widens its peer range.
